settings.text: Lights, decorations and gifts at fair prices. Order by {date} and it arrives before the 24th.
settings.text_after_deadline: Lights, decorations and gifts at fair prices. Orders placed now may arrive after Christmas.

settings.heading: Warm light, all season.
settings.text: Fairy, icicle and festoon lights for the tree, the window, the mantel and the front door.

settings.heading: Gifts for everyone.
settings.text: Stocking fillers, thoughtful extras and bigger presents, sorted by what you want to spend.

settings.heading: Gifts by budget
settings.text: Stocking fillers and small gifts that arrive in time.

settings.heading: We dispatch
settings.text: Packed and sent within {dispatch}. You get a tracking link by email.

settings.heading: It arrives

settings.question: When do I need to order by?
settings.answer: Order by {date} and your order should arrive before Christmas Eve. After that date we cannot promise Christmas delivery, and your cart will say so before you pay.

settings.question: Where do the products ship from?
settings.answer: Most products are sent directly from our supplier partners' warehouses, so one order can arrive in more than one parcel. Each parcel has its own tracking link, sent by email when it leaves the warehouse.

settings.question: How much is delivery?
settings.answer: Delivery is {shipping_fee}, and free when your order is {free_shipping} or more. The total is shown in your cart before checkout. VAT is included in every price.

settings.question: Can I send something back?
settings.answer: Yes. You can return unused items within {returns} days of receiving them. Start a return by emailing us and we will send the instructions. Read the returns policy.

settings.question: How do I know the products are safe?
settings.answer: Every product page has a Safety and manufacturer information section with the manufacturer's name and address and any warnings. Indoor lights are for indoor use only; outdoor lights say so on the page.

settings.heading: Questions, answered
settings.text: Still unsure? Write to {email} and we reply within one working day.

settings.heading: Get the last-order reminder
settings.text: One email a few days before the cut-off date. Nothing else.
settings.consent: By subscribing you agree to receive emails from us. You can unsubscribe at any time.
